validate.custom: var remaining = Number(data.transportRemainingSeats); var passengers = Number(input || 0); if (!isNaN(remaining) && remaining >= 0 && passengers > remaining) { valid = 'عدد الركاب يجب ألا يتجاوز المقاعد المتبقية (' + remaining + ').'; } else { valid = true; }

components.calculateValue: var passengers = Number(data.passengers || 0); function empty() { value = ''; } function send(url) { var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest(); xhr.open('GET', url, false); xhr.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'application/json'); xhr.send(null); if (xhr.status < 200 || xhr.status >= 300 || !xhr.responseText) { return null; } return JSON.parse(xhr.responseText); } if (!data.reservationUrl || !data.weeks || !data.propertyWithFloor) { empty(); } else { try { var ts = Date.now(); var priceUrl = data.reservationUrl + '/api/Reservation/price/' + encodeURIComponent(data.weeks) + '/' + encodeURIComponent(data.propertyWithFloor) + '?passengers=' + encodeURIComponent(passengers) + '&_ts=' + ts; var transportUrl = data.reservationUrl + '/api/Reservation/transport-status/' + encodeURIComponent(data.weeks) + '?passengers=' + encodeURIComponent(passengers) + '&_ts=' + ts; var priceRes = send(priceUrl) || {}; var transportRes = send(transportUrl) || {}; value = JSON.stringify({ price: priceRes, transport: transportRes.transport || {} }); } catch (e) { empty(); } }
